function: Time-domain MIMO channel prediction: forecast NL future CSI frames from NP past estimated frames at the base station (p. 3).
system: 2 receive by 4 transmit antennas, TDD, no RIS; frequency band not stated; user speeds up to 300 km/h (pp. 2, 7, 11).
method: Encoder-only all-linear Transformer (time-aware MLP replaces attention); supervised, weighted-MSE loss with noise augmentation; pretrained on simulation, fine-tuned on measured CSI (pp. 4-8, 11).
data_channel: Simulated 3GPP CDL-B channels from MATLAB 5G Toolbox (11,000 frames per speed and delay spread); measured V2X vehicle-to-roadside-unit CSI for fine-tuning and test (pp. 8, 11).
test_conditions: Simulation: first 10,000 frames train, last 1,000 test, same speeds, delay spreads, SNR 0-20 dB. Measured: fine-tune on 750 samples, test on 50 held-out segment samples (pp. 8, 11-12).
baselines: Learned: LSTM, GRU, Transformer. Non-learned: outdated CSI and MMSE channel estimation (pp. 8-9).
metrics: MSE (dB) per predicted frame, MRT channel capacity (bit/s/Hz), inference speed (samples/s), number of parameters (pp. 8-11).
complexity: Multiplication-count order in Eq. 24 (p. 7); about 15M parameters versus 30M for the Transformer (p. 8); inference under 2 ms on a GTX 1050 Ti (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 8: "Standardized clustered delay line (CDL) model [39]"; p. 8: "based on the CDL-B model"; p. 13: "Tech. Rep. 38.901"

q3_support: p. 8: "comparative analysis of the proposed LinFormer, Transformer, GRU and LSTM models in terms of channel prediction MSE"; p. 9: "surpasses the immediate MMSE channel estimation for future time steps"
q4_support: p. 7: "Proposition 1. The computational complexity of the proposed LinFormer is"; p. 8: "has about 15 million parameters"

notes: PDF is the arXiv version (2410.21351v1) of the LinFormer paper; it prints no DOI, so the DOI match rests on the title. q5 rests only on the measured-data clause: no code or data link appears, and the measured CSI comes from the cited campaign [43]; reviewer to confirm that fine-tuning and testing on measured CSI counts. q1 rests on the CDL-B profile via TR 38.901 [39] (p. 13). Frequency band is not stated (Table I, p. 12, gives only sample rate 200 MHz).
